learning_outcomes.text: Structure a three-statement-style model with clear inputs and drivers
Use financial functions (NPV, IRR, PMT) correctly
Build scenarios with Scenario Manager and data tables
Run sensitivity analysis on key assumptions
Document assumptions and check a model for integrity

integrative_case: An analyst must appraise a capital project: build a driver-based cash-flow model, compute NPV and IRR, test best/base/worst scenarios, run a two-variable sensitivity table on price and volume, and document the assumptions for a review meeting.
